notes: Reports dashboard blank-report fix for the Vita Nova Staff software.
Fixes Housing & Intake > Journey Summary appearing blank by giving Overview its own mirror tables instead of reusing the same table component across multiple tabs.
Fixes Intake Timing appearing empty by correctly parsing timestamp-style intake packet dates such as yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.
Adds an Intake Timing fallback so imported/journey-derived intake timing can populate the report when official packet timing has no rows.
Builds on Vita Nova Staff 1.0.114 and keeps Java 25 bytecode compatibility for staff computers.
